items.title: React Notes Management App
items.shortDescription: An interactive application for creating, editing, deleting, and locally saving notes.
items.overview: A notes management web application built with React and LocalStorage. Users can create, view, edit, and delete notes through an interactive interface, with data stored directly in the browser without requiring an external server. Developed as part of the JavaScript Application Development course at Hsoub Academy.
features: Update the interface interactively with React
responsibilities: Developing the user interface using React (sample wording)
Implementing note creation, editing, and deletion (sample wording)
Connecting notes to browser local storage (sample wording)
